messages:
Alex Chen: Morning async — quick pipeline + security check. TL;DR: MacroHealth wants private deployment + customer-managed HSM for key material; they want answers by EOW.

Alex Chen: What I did: updated SOW draft with cost estimates and Scheduled demo Wed 10am PT. Blockers: need security confirmation on HSM latency impact and SSO options. Today: get sec review, update quote, prep demo slides.

Maria Gonzalez: FYI sales asked whether we can include SOC2 language in the SOW. We have SOC2 Type II in progress — how should we phrase it to not overpromise? @Priya Kumar

Daniel Patel: Demo is locked for Wed 10am PT. I'll include a short slide on private deployment topology and fallback options. Need a small network diagram + exact ports so the customer can route. Also need the HSM unwrap latency numbers for an honest perf note.

Sara Liu: Quick check from dev experiments: local HSM emulator showed key unwrap p99 ~60-120ms on cold path; with caching it drops to ~2–5ms. That coldstart tail could matter for low-latency inference. Suggest we propose a key-cache shim or a local KMS proxy as part of the private package. cc @sec-bot

Priya Kumar: Pinged sec team in their queue. @sec-bot can you confirm: 1) acceptable HSM latency guidance for enterprise deals, 2) recommended KMS/HSM vendors we can suggest, and 3) SSO guidance (SAML vs OIDC) for Private installs?

sec-bot: Auto-created ticket SEC-2026 for HSM latency + SSO guidance. ETA 2 business days. Link: https://redwood.internal/SEC-2026 — assigning to SecOps.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Maria, can you add fallback language in the SOW: 'We can deliver dedicated capacity without external HSM if customer prioritizes latency; HSM option available with defined perf caveats'? Also need clarity on SSO — customer prefers SAML but will accept OIDC if supported.

Maria Gonzalez: Yep will add the fallback clause. Also customer asked about EU-only hosting / data residency. Do we have a standard EU addendum? @Priya Kumar

Priya Kumar: Use the EU data region addendum template: https://redwood.internal/templates/eu-data-addendum.docx — I'll attach it to the quote. I'll also draft the SSO options blurb (SAML + OIDC supported, recommend SAML for corporate SSO).

Daniel Patel: For the network diagram / minimal ports, here's what to propose to the customer:
```
ingress: 443 (customer -> runtime),
outbound: 443 (runtime -> model-repo.redwood.net:443),
health/checks: 443,
optional: 10250 (kube node mgmt) only if customer wants node-level ops access.
```
Can infra confirm if that looks sanitized enough for customer handoff? @Sara Liu

Sara Liu: Infra confirmed: only 443 required for normal deployments; we don't expose 10250 by default. I'll produce a sanitized diagram and attach it after lunch.

Alex Chen: Action items: @Priya update SOW + attach EU addendum, @Maria update quote to include fallback & perf caveat, @Daniel prep demo slides and include key-cache pattern, @SecOps respond to SEC-2026 with HSM latency guidance & SSO recommendation by EOW. If anyone hits blockers ping here. :thumbsup:

Maria Gonzalez: One more — the customer asked about contract SLA for Dedicated capacity. Is there a standardized SLA doc we can link?

Priya Kumar: Yes, SLA template is in contracts repo, I'll attach it to the quote as well.

Daniel Patel: Cool — I'll slot a 10-min perf caveats section in the demo. If SecOps posts anything earlier, I'll include it.

Alex Chen: Great, thanks team. If no other blockers I'll close this thread after the demo slides are in.

(End of thread)
